title: Wu Lengshuang, the Soft Sword (柔剑 武林霜) - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: Wu Lengshuang, the Soft Sword (柔剑 武林霜) in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.
keyword: Wu Lengshuang, the Soft Sword (柔剑 武林霜) phantom blade zero boss

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Wu Lengshuang, the Soft Sword (柔剑 武林霜) is an optional encounter in Mandate Encampment, found at Path of the Baishan's Fall. Beating it yields Soft Snake Sword.

sections.title: Where to Find the Wu Lengshuang, the Soft Sword (柔剑 武林霜)
sections.content:
Location: Path of the Baishan's Fall.

Appears in: Mandate Encampment.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is optional, which is why it can be left until the Sha-Chi pool and the Phantom Edge roster are deeper.

sections.title: How to Beat the Wu Lengshuang, the Soft Sword (柔剑 武林霜)
sections.content:
Wu Lengshuang is a parry duel rather than a damage race. She deflects constantly, and every deflection is a purple flash that cancels your damage and leads straight into a counter whose colour tells you what to do: red means dodge, blue means parry, no colour means block or reposition.

The mistake that loses this fight is pressing through the purple flash. Treat it as a stop signal, react to the counter, and take the acrobatic flip slash as your one reliable Ghoststep opening.

Attacks worth knowing

AttackWhat it doesAnswer
Purple flashShe parries you mid-stringStop attacking immediately
Counter after purpleRed glint = unblockable, blue = parryableDodge the red, parry the blue
Two-handed swingOnly attack she uses two hands forAlways followed by an unblockable spin - dodge it
Acrobatic slashForward flip, wide slashParryable - this is your Ghoststep opening

What works

  • Stop attacking the moment the purple flash appears - that is her parry, and a counter is already coming.
  • Dodge when the follow-up glints red, parry when it glints blue.
  • Her only two-handed swing is always followed by an unblockable spinning slash.
  • The acrobatic forward flip slash is parryable and is her main gap closer.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 37 of 60 in the progression order, in Mandate Encampment. Before it: Red, the Mysterious Wraith. After it: Chief Disciple of the Seven-Stars Formation. The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
